about: The cost model's rates and assumptions (issue #31). Every dollar the tools return is a quantity from the records times one of these. Defaults are the owner's post; nothing here is a real plant's figure. Override a rate with INVESTIGATOR_RATES=paper:55,hour:1200,margin:40 on the server, or rates= on a request or URL (docs/COST_MODEL.md).

rates.label: Paper
rates.note: The paper in a thousand square feet of combined board (liners and medium, the medium's take-up included), not a single paper grade's price; prices waste board (trim, shear, rejects), which is combined board.

rates.label: Machine time
rates.note: Bottleneck shadow price of corrugator time (the post: more than $1,200 an hour); prices downtime, the speed gap and the run time shear and rejects consumed.

rates.label: Board contribution margin
rates.note: Not in the post. Prices the board not made; until it is set every contribution figure reads 'margin not set', never $0.

rates.label: Side-trim target
rates.note: The owner's side-trim target (targets.json, issue #101); trim points over it are the trim lever. 3.25% is the flag, 2.75% a home run.

assumptions.label: Annual volume per machine
assumptions.note: The post's 3.6M MSF a year across two machines.
